Deadline extended and submission form for Authors

April 25, 2022 By admin In ELO 2022 2 Comments
Full paper submission deadline extended: May 2, 2022. The ELO 2022 Conference accepts both abstracts and full papers. If you insert in the online form only the abstract you will be able to present your work at the Conference and we will include the abstract in the Conference Guide. If you insert (upload) also the full paper, we will be glad to include it in the Conference Proceedings. Here the form to fill: https://forms.gle/tzDDMtiFZaWEWeq99
